label: Application through one specified exercise gives both agents credit at the same realized result
paraphrase: For any supplied exercise and event-to-respect map, a source applying a secondary agent through the selected stroke towards the selected result on the ThroughAt reading has a productive path from some of its events to that exact result. There is also a nonempty path from the secondary stroke to that result. Each agent has bearer-level credit for the patient in the result's respect on the existential projection. This path result is conditional on the interpreted contributor records; it does not identify causing esse with causing every other actuality.
